title: Object cohomology stalks are homology of stalkwise sections
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale any functor between the Zariski open category [def-sc-zariski-site] and the etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], F an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], x a point and q a natural number. Assume HasSheafify with coefficients AddCommGrpCat in universe u+1 and HasExt in arbitrary universe w [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define E on a sheaf G to be colim over open neighbourhoods U of x of G(i(U)), with the actual restriction maps. There exists an injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and an additive equivalence from colim of the object cohomology presheaf H^q(i(U),F), lifted into universe max(u+2,w), to H^q(E(I)).

source.place: Section 01FT (cohomology over an object); Tag 03F3, proof (evaluation of an injective resolution); etale-cohomology.tex, Tags 03XA and 09AX. Read from the local Stacks source mirror and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F3.

proof.text: Use Mathlib Scheme.isGrothendieckAbelian_sheaf_smallEtaleTopology at scheme and coefficient universe u+1. The affine etale site is essentially small in u+1 and is a dense subsite. The equivalence gives the Grothendieck abelian instance and hence enough injectives. Take the actual Mathlib injectiveResolution F.
Apply objectCohomologyPresheaf_resolution to this resolution. Restrict its natural isomorphism along the opposite open-neighbourhood inclusion followed by i, and apply colim.mapIso.

The restriction functor on presheaves is exact and the opposite open-neighbourhood category is filtered. Thus their composite R with colim preserves homology. Apply (K.sc q).mapHomologyIso R to the presheaf resolution K. Use preservesColimitIso for AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor to move the lift outside the colimit; map the inverse homology comparison through that lift. The resulting category isomorphism gives an additive equivalence, and AddEquiv.ulift removes the lift on its codomain. The evaluated complex is definitionally the complex in the original conclusion.

proof_origin.place: D3 Lean reduction of the existing resolution plan: Mathlib injectiveResolution, natural presheaf comparison, exact restriction/filtered colimit, ULift colimit comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleObjectCohomology_stalk_complex
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (x : X) :
    ∃ I : InjectiveResolution F,
      Nonempty
        (↑(colimit
          (((OpenNhds.inclusion (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x) ⋙ i).op ⋙
            Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 2, w})) ≃+
          (((etaleObjectStalkSections X i x).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
            I.cocomplex).homology q)
